title: Understand Area
goal: Explain area as the amount of surface inside a figure, measured by counting unit squares in a tiling without gaps or overlaps.

concepts.name: Area measures inside
concepts.teach: Area is the amount of surface inside a flat shape, not the distance around its edge.

check.question: Does area measure the inside or the outside edge?

concepts.name: Unit squares
concepts.teach: A unit square has side lengths of one unit. Equal-sized unit squares let us measure area.

check.question: How long is each side of a unit square?

concepts.name: No gaps or overlaps
concepts.teach: Tiling covers a region with unit squares that fit without gaps or overlaps.

check.question: Why can't we leave gaps between the tiles?
check.answer: the region would not be completely covered

concepts.name: Count unit squares
concepts.teach: Count each square exactly once, using rows to stay organized.

check.question: How many unit squares cover this 3-row, 5-column rectangle?

concepts.name: Complete a partial tiling
concepts.teach: If only some squares are shown, imagine how many more squares fill the whole shape without gaps.

check.question: How many unit squares cover the completed 3-row, 4-column rectangle?

assessment.question: Which tiling measures area correctly?
options: Squares with no gaps or overlaps
